description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on it.
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing those counters, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.
